questions.author: Optometry Study Hub content preparation

questions.stem: A patient wears +7.00 D lenses. The finished optical centres are each 2 mm temporal to the intended visual axes. Calculate the prism magnitude in each lens, discuss likely symptoms and describe the verification steps before remake.
questions.explanation: Each lens induces 0.2 x 7.00 = 1.4Δ. The exact base direction should be determined from the plus-lens optical-centre displacement relative to the visual axis. The high power makes this clinically important. Recheck the order, monocular PDs, frame datum and on-face position, then verify the finished centres and powers before remaking.

questions.stem: Write a complete standard operating sequence for dispensing a first pair of progressive spectacles, from history to follow-up.
questions.explanation: Begin with task history and expectations, then select and fully adjust a suitable frame. Measure monocular PDs and separate fitting heights in natural posture. Verify power, axis, add, prism, coatings, centration and frame mechanics. On the patient, confirm alignment, distance/intermediate/near function and comfort. Teach zone use and adaptation, record all data and investigate persistent symptoms systematically.
